info.scriptSrcText: property delayCountglobal gSeaFrameon beginSprite  delayCount = 0  gSeaFrame = 1endon exitFrame  delayCount = delayCount + 1  if delayCount > 3 then    gSeaFrame = gSeaFrame + 1    if gSeaFrame > 20 then      gSeaFrame = 1    end if    delayCount = 0  end ifend
info.name: SeaFrameCounter
